research_notes: If the target succeeds, the 16m probe should use a similarly non-exhausting but bounded mixed workload.
The workload generator should scale with target so under-target exhaustion does not recur at longer classes.
A simple rule is to predeclare a generous bounded analytical backlog and permit bounded extensions only while novel research work remains.
This avoids both artificial waiting and accidental early exhaustion.
Near the failure boundary, checkpoint cadence should remain sufficient to localize termination timing.
After boundary characterization, checkpoint overhead itself can be optimized if it materially reduces useful throughput.
